case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

move.subject: SH-220: revised commercial and delivery terms
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Offer offer:DEMO-C1-0 quotes €16.00 per shaft; could you share the material, machining and logistics cost breakdown and identify scope for a reduction?

Could you confirm your earliest repeatable lead time and quote the packages below? We propose 35 days for delivery and offer shorter payment terms in the second package in exchange for a lower price. Please also indicate whether consolidated shipments could make DAP more economical.

Both packages retain the enquiry’s fixed contract terms. We look forward to your revised quotation.

Best regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to present our offer of a price of €16.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery FCA. This offer is valid for 30 days.

We welcome your proposal for 30-day payment terms and a 35-day lead time. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Alternatively, with delivery EXW: €15.90 per unit.

The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our colleagues will address your questions regarding the cost breakdown and delivery options. Please note that any further step needs approval from our management.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We can propose a price of €15.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.

The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. With the 35 days lead time you offered, we can drop the price to 15.60 EUR. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. We have free capacity for your parts.

My guys will answer your questions about the machining and costs. Please find our cost breakdown attached. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

move.subject: SH-220: revised packages for management review
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for revising your quotation. Could you seek management approval for either package below?

We have increased our proposed FCA price modestly. The second package offers payment within 14 days in exchange for a further price reduction. Both retain a 35-day lead time and the fixed contract terms.

What reduction could faster payment support? Could consolidated shipments make DAP competitive with FCA, and what would the additional delivered cost be?

Please keep the current quotation available while these packages are reviewed.

Best regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:

Our management has approved a further step. With management approval, we are pleased to offer €15.90 per unit for 14 days payment and FCA delivery. Beside this option, our Angebot stands at a price of €16.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery FCA. As an alternative, we present a price of €15.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery FCA. 

Our colleagues will address your questions regarding DAP delivery options. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: SH-220: Preis und Zahlungsziel abstimmen
move.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,

vielen Dank für die Prüfung. Welchen konkreten Preisnachlass können Sie für die schnelle Zahlung gegenüber Ihrem üblichen Zahlungsziel gewähren?

Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Cash is king right now, so we really like the 14 days payment. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. With the 14 days payment, I can drop the price to 15.40 EUR. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

My guys will check if bundling the production runs can save us some setup time. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

messages.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and the further step in price. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €16.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. In response, we are pleased to offer €15.80 per unit for 14 days payment and FCA delivery, with a price of €15.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery FCA. 

Our colleagues will address your questions regarding DAP delivery and contract terms. Please note that our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium.
